## File: settings-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Top-level Settings menu that exposes submenus for path
## configuration, naming, export options, registry, and feature toggles.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.settings
  name: "Settings Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Top-level settings menu for paths, naming, export, and registry."

header:
  type: "settings_features"

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.select-universe"
    label: "Select Active Universe Folder Path"
    description: "Set the active tenant-universe workspace root. Triggers bootstrap on empty folders."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    args:
      key_value: "workspace_root"
      pick_mode: "folder"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.default-folder-paths"
    label: "Default Folder Paths"
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.paths"

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.ignore-file-types"
    label: "Ignore File Types"
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-ignore"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.ignore"

  - key: "4"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.auto-archive"
    label: "Auto-Archive (toggle)"
    description: "Automatically archive previous file versions before overwriting. Stored in settings.features.autoArchive."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-auto-archive"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "5"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.auto-versioning"
    label: "Auto-Versioning (toggle)"
    description: "Automatically increment the version field when creating new versions. Stored in settings.features.autoVersioning."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-auto-versioning"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "6"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.export"
    label: "Export Settings"
    description: "Configure default export type, allowed extensions, and version suffix behavior."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-export"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.export"

  - key: "7"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.registry"
    label: "Registry Configuration"
    description: "Set registry path, semantic rules, and key synonym mappings."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-registry"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.registry"
